answer: At the dawn of every epoch, bonded agents register polynomial commitments rooted like cedar trees in the Semaphore state. Sybil resistance relies on evaluating this epoch polynomial; generating duplicate messages over the consensus ledge reveals distinct points on a 2-share Shamir threshold. By Lagrange interpolation, rival peers reconstruct the offending agent's private key, triggering deterministic, instantaneous collateral slashing across the distributed network.
